thread:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502 / 504 + auth retries hitting the hosted inference API in SJC starting ~10:03 UTC. Telemetry: spike in token latency and gateway 5xx from sjc-a -> sjc-b paths.
aj: Confirmed. Gateway error rate jumped ~18% at 10:04 UTC. No recent deploys on the gateway. Seeing a lot of client retry storms making it worse.
sasha: Net metrics show 3–6% packet loss on the transit path (ASN 64500) and increased TCP retransmits. BGP AS PATH changes observed around 10:02 UTC, multiple ECMP flips.
kevin: Can we fail traffic to backup transit / partner peering? If we have a quick alternate path we should shift. Opening provider ticket now.
maria: Support escalations coming in: some enterprise customers seeing auth token exchange failures followed by 502s. Can support freeze billing for affected accounts while we investigate? @support-bot please list affected enterprise IDs.
support-bot: Created INC-3589, owners pinned: maria, aj. Affected accounts tracked: [acct-redwood-410, acct-lumenai, acct-devco]. Notify sent to SEs.
netbot: Quick trace sample attached:
```
$ traceroute -n 34.12.23.45
1  10.0.0.1  0.6 ms
2  10.1.5.1  0.9 ms
3  198.51.100.2  3.8 ms  (transit-64500)  packet loss 28%
4  198.51.100.3  40.2 ms  AS PATH change seen
5  34.12.23.45  * * *
```
aj: Deployed an emergency mitigation: pinned a subset of gateway instances to local peering and disabled cross-AZ routing for canary tenants (~10:15 UTC). Error rate dropped ~60% for pinned traffic but global 5xx still elevated due to clients that hit non-pinned paths.
sasha: Provider ack'd an issue — partial fiber cut + rapid ECMP reweighting causing asymmetric routing and packet loss. They say they'll reroute but no firm ETA. Asking for MOAS withdraw on flapping prefixes.
kevin: Action items (I'll own provider escalation):
- escalate provider ticket, request immediate cyan path cutover and commit times
- keep canary pinned to local peering for 30m and monitor
- throttle upstream retries in API gateway to reduce retry amplification (change default retries -> exponential backoff)
- add temporary route preference to avoid the affected transit ASN where possible
maria: Support, please collect sample request IDs, timestamps, and affected zones for postmortem. I'll draft customer comms and update status page (short incident note + ETA TBD). @aj @sasha please add logs/traces to the incident doc. :loudspeaker:
aj: Adding logs now, pushing minimal gateway config to reduce retries: `gateway.retry.max=2 gateway.retry.backoff=exp`. Rolling to all regions in 5m.
sasha: Monitoring — packet loss trending down to ~8% after partial reroute, latency still spike-y. Will keep eyes on retransmit rate and KV cache misses (expect regen after path changes).
maria: Thanks team. If provider gives ETA, we'll coordinate an incident update and follow with a postmortem. For now mitigation = local peering + retry throttling + support outreach.
kevin: Provider sync call scheduled in 10m, I'll report back.
support-bot: Noted, INC-3589 updated with current mitigations and affected account list.
maria: Closing loop for now — keeping thread open until provider confirms stable routing.
